# Pixel Universe feature artwork — source-driven final design

**Source of truth:** `archive/projects/2026-11-pixel-universe/data/feature_pixelstudio_16x16.txt`. This contains the exact **256-character hexadecimal code** for an editable **16×16 Pixel Art Studio** design. It is *not* a 13th character from the costume dataset.

**Asset:** `site/assets/pixel-universe/feature-pixel-identity.svg`, deterministically regenerated by `archive/projects/2026-11-pixel-universe/scripts/render_feature_pixelstudio.py`.

**Editorial concept:** An anonymous, abstract pixel mask and shoulders, with individual detached pixel squares on **all four sides** (top, bottom, left and right). It suggests how a recognisable silhouette can emerge from a few coloured squares. No franchise emblem, face or copyrighted character drawing.

**Pixel accuracy:** 16×16 cells, 256 total. The source code is decoded with the **actual Studio palette** from `site/assets/js/pixel-art-builder.js`. Non-empty cells are drawn as exactly **70×70 px** rectangles on a regular **76 px** lattice, starting at **(192,192)** on a **1600×1600** SVG. There are **95 painted cells**, of which **8 are muted Studio red**; blank cells show the website's `#F3F4F6` paper. Each painted cell uses the same size and grid spacing, including the isolated halo fragments.

**Source palette:** Studio Black `#111111`, Slate `#7B898F` and Red `#C34635`. No colours outside the existing Studio 16-swatch palette. This is the approved exception to the usual charcoal/`#C44E52` *illustration accent*: an exact editor-compatible colour scheme takes precedence over inventing non-editable colours. The background is still the house light grey `#F3F4F6`.

**Alt text:** An anonymous black and slate pixel mask built from equal-sized squares, with a few red accents and individual pixels scattered around all sides.

**Editable in the Studio:** `https://coffeetableviz.com/resources/8x8-pixel-art-builder/#size=16&art=<256-hex-character source code>` (insert the exact source-code text without brackets). Unlike an AI illustration, this SVG is fully reproducible from the editable Studio cells.

**Before publication:** run `python archive/projects/2026-11-pixel-universe/scripts/render_feature_pixelstudio.py --check`, the Pixel Universe pytest suite and Jekyll build, then confirm the exact SVG on the article/card and deployment status. User approved the concept and specifically requested this deterministic equal-square implementation and publication.
